'''Camp Overwatch''' is an area of {{Location|Desorock Highland}}

==Description==
Camp Overwatch is one of the largest military installations in [[Jinzhou]], designed to act as the primary line of defense against the [[Norfall Barrens]]. 

==Features==
One of the [[Torn Pages from Desorock Highland]] can be found here, near [[Fusheng]].
